verses.en: And God spake all these words, saying,
verses.pt: Então falou Deus todas estas palavras, dizendo:
verses.en_web: God spoke all these words, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And God said all these words:

verses.en: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.pt: Eu sou o Senhor teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão.
verses.en_web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.en_bbe: I am the Lord your God who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.

verses.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
verses.pt: Não terás outros deuses diante de mim.
verses.en_web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.en_bbe: You are to have no other gods but me.

verses.en: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.pt: Não farás para ti imagem esculpida, nem figura alguma do que há em cima no céu, nem em baixo na terra, nem nas águas debaixo da terra.
verses.en_web: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.en_bbe: You are not to make an image or picture of anything in heaven or on the earth or in the waters under the earth:

verses.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.pt: Não te encurvarás diante delas, nem as servirás; porque eu, o Senhor teu Deus, sou Deus zeloso, que visito a iniqüidade dos pais nos filhos até a terceira e quarta geração daqueles que me odeiam.
verses.en_web: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,
verses.en_bbe: You may not go down on your faces before them or give them worship: for I, the Lord your God, am a God who will not give his honour to another; and I will send punishment on the children for the wrongdoing of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation of my haters;

verses.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.pt: e uso de misericórdia com milhares dos que me amam e guardam os meus mandamentos.
verses.en_web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
verses.en_bbe: And I will have mercy through a thousand generations on those who have love for me and keep my laws.

verses.en: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.pt: Não tomarás o nome do Senhor teu Deus em vão; porque o Senhor não terá por inocente aquele que tomar o seu nome em vão.
verses.en_web: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
verses.en_bbe: You are not to make use of the name of the Lord your God for an evil purpose; whoever takes the Lord's name on his lips for an evil purpose will be judged a sinner by the Lord

verses.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.pt: Lembra-te do dia do sábado, para o santificar.
verses.en_web: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in memory the Sabbath and let it be a holy day.

verses.en: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
verses.pt: Seis dias trabalharás, e farás todo o teu trabalho;
verses.en_web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,
verses.en_bbe: On six days do all your work:

verses.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
verses.pt: mas o sétimo dia é o sábado do Senhor teu Deus. Nesse dia não farás trabalho algum, nem tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem o teu servo, nem a tua serva, nem o teu animal, nem o estrangeiro que está dentro das tuas portas.
verses.en_web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;
verses.en_bbe: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; on that day you are to do no work, you or your son or your daughter, your man-servant or your woman-servant, your cattle or the man from a strange country who is living among you:

verses.en: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.pt: Porque em seis dias fez o Senhor o céu e a terra, o mar e tudo o que neles há, e ao sétimo dia descansou; por isso o Senhor abençoou o dia do sábado, e o santificou.
verses.en_web: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.
verses.en_bbe: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and the sea, and everything in them, and he took his rest on the seventh day: for this reason the Lord has given his blessing to the seventh day and made it holy.

verses.en: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.pt: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, para que se prolonguem os teus dias na terra que o Senhor teu Deus te dá.
verses.en_web: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to your father and to your mother, so that your life may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.

verses.en: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.pt: Não matarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not murder.
verses.en_bbe: Do not put anyone to death without cause.

verses.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
verses.pt: Não adulterarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not commit adultery.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be false to the married relation.

verses.en: Thou shalt not steal.
verses.pt: Não furtarás.
verses.en_web: “You shall not steal.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take the property of another.

verses.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.pt: Não dirás falso testemunho contra o teu proximo.
verses.en_web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give false witness against your neighbour.

verses.en: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
verses.pt: Não cobiçarás a casa do teu próximo, não cobiçarás a mulher do teu próximo, nem o seu servo, nem a sua serva, nem o seu boi, nem o seu jumento, nem coisa alguma do teu próximo.
verses.en_web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”
verses.en_bbe: Let not your desire be turned to your neighbour's house, or his wife or his man-servant or his woman-servant or his ox or his ass or anything which is his.

verses.en: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.pt: Ora, todo o povo presenciava os trovões, e os relâmpagos, e o sonido da buzina, e o monte a fumegar; e o povo, vendo isso, estremeceu e pôs-se de longe.
verses.en_web: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people were watching the thunderings and the flames and the sound of the horn and the mountain smoking; and when they saw it, they kept far off, shaking with fear.

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
verses.pt: E disseram a Moisés: Fala-nos tu mesmo, e ouviremos; mas não fale Deus conosco, para que não morramos.
verses.en_web: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to Moses, To your words we will give ear, but let not the voice of God come to our ears, for fear death may come on us.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
verses.pt: Respondeu Moisés ao povo: Não temais, porque Deus veio para vos provar, e para que o seu temor esteja diante de vós, a fim de que não pequeis.
verses.en_web: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the people, Have no fear: for God has come to put you to the test, so that fearing him you may be kept from sin.

verses.en: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
verses.pt: Assim o povo estava em pé de longe; Moisés, porém, se chegou às trevas espessas onde Deus estava.
verses.en_web: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
verses.en_bbe: And the people kept their places far off, but Moses went near to the dark cloud where God was.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: Vós tendes visto que do céu eu vos falei.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You yourselves have seen that my voice has come to you from heaven

verses.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
verses.pt: Não fareis outros deuses comigo; deuses de prata, ou deuses de ouro, não os fareis para vós.
verses.en_web: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.
verses.en_bbe: Gods of silver and gods of gold you are not to make for yourselves.

verses.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
verses.pt: um altar de terra me farás, e sobre ele sacrificarás os teus holocaustos, e as tuas ofertas pacíficas, as tuas ovelhas e os teus bois. Em todo lugar em que eu fizer recordar o meu nome, virei a ti e te abençoarei.
verses.en_web: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.
verses.en_bbe: Make for me an altar of earth, offering on it your burned offerings and your peace-offerings, your sheep and your oxen: in every place where I have put the memory of my name, I will come to you and give you my blessing.

verses.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
verses.pt: E se me fizeres um altar de pedras, não o construirás de pedras lavradas; pois se sobre ele levantares o teu buril, profaná-lo-ás.
verses.en_web: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
verses.en_bbe: And if you make me an altar of stone do not make it of cut stones: for the touch of an instrument will make it unclean.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.pt: Também não subirás ao meu altar por degraus, para que não seja ali exposta a tua nudez.
verses.en_web: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
verses.en_bbe: And do not go up by steps to my altar, for fear that your bodies may be seen uncovered.
